question: What sort of feelings does Frederica-san have towards Otto?
answer: He's a man who shoulders many responsibilities, so there's no end to his troubles. We're a camp where men who aren't like that are uncommon, though...... no one would complain if he set down his burdens a little bit. I'm sure he himself is the last one who would allow that. That part of Otto-sama really is what makes him Otto-sama.
